newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury says new card report speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury says new card report speculation.

text.p: British supermarket group J. Sainsbury Plc dismissed as "just speculation" a report in the Observer newspaper that it was planning a card which would give shoppers a bank account with the store.

"It's just speculation," a spokeswoman told Reuters. The newspaper said the account would be different from that of arch-rival Tesco, which launched its ClubCard Plus companion card to its ClubCard loyalty scheme in June giving customers a five percent gross per year interest rate on accounts in credit.

The Sainsbury spokeswoman reiterated the store's plans to expand from its own Reward loyalty card scheme which debuted in June but said any introduction of a debit or credit card was unlikely this year.
"At this stage no decision has been made...it's a looking-at situation," she said.
Sainsbury said in June when it launched Reward that a payment card would be added in the future.
It finally gave in to pressure to launch the card after the success of ClubCard helped Tesco become market leader last year, ousting Sainsbury from the top slot. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427717
